REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: The RCA schema does not enforce the contract’s counterfactual-evidence requirement when a model profile is named as the primary cause. It therefore permits unsupported model blame despite the prose contract.
FINDING: high|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.root-cause-analysis-v1.schema.json|A record may set primary_cause to skill_or_model_profile while omitting model_profile_causal_claim and counterfactual_evidence|The conditional activates only when an optional boolean is explicitly true, violating the requirement that model-profile causality always have counterfactual evidence
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Tie the schema condition directly to primary_cause=skill_or_model_profile, requiring model_profile_causal_claim=true and a nonempty counterfactual_evidence array; alternatively split skill and model-profile causes into distinct enum values and enforce this only for model_profile
COUNTEREXAMPLE: {"schema":"factory.root-cause-analysis/v1","incident_id":"hidden-holdout-1","provenance_sha256":"sha256:x","primary_cause":"skill_or_model_profile","evidence":["Qwen patch failed hidden holdout"],"corrective_ticket_ids":[],"status":"open"}
